name: Area X
author: Taylor Remigi
description: Area X, for the Annihilation theme: a slow iridescent wallpaper layer, light spilling over window edges, a screensaver whose words are made of living creatures, and a bar glyph with the expedition log. Dormant on every other theme.

barWidget.description: A prism that shifts through the Shimmer's colours, with the expedition log and controls
